Subject: OrbitData POC outcomes + quick endorsement and logo use?

Hi Tara / Samir,

Thanks again for running the two-week pilot with us — really appreciated the partnership and the thoughtful feedback from your engineering team. Attached is a one-page summary of the POC results, but the high-level outcomes we saw were:

- 48% reduction in average inference latency at 1k concurrency (p95 from 420ms -> 220ms)
- 31% lower cost per inference after batching/kv-cache tweaks compared to your existing setup
- Stable throughput over a sustained 30-minute run with no tail latency spikes
- Integration time (end-to-end) ~ 3 days with our deployment templates

We’re preparing a short customer highlight (1–2 paragraphs + a pull quote) and would love to feature OrbitData. Would you be comfortable with:

1) A one-line endorsement we can use in our marketing (ideally 10–25 words). If it helps, we can propose a draft.
2) Permission to use OrbitData’s company logo in the case study.
3) Optionally, a 20-minute reference call next week for prospective customers (no sales deck, just Q&A).

If you prefer, you can reply with a quick blurb and we’ll send the final version for sign-off.

Attachment: POC_results_summary.pdf (PDF, 210 KB)

Thanks — happy to coordinate timing.

Best,
Rafael Mendes
